meta.title: CC1101 Low-Power Sub-1 GHz RF Transceiver
meta.summary: Sub-1 GHz transceiver for the 315/433/868/915 MHz ISM/SRD bands (300–348, 387–464, 779–928 MHz). Supports 2-FSK, GFSK, 4-FSK, MSK and ASK/OOK at 0.6–500 kBaud, up to +12 dBm output and down to −116 dBm sensitivity. Carrier frequency, data rate, deviation and channel filter are set with mantissa/exponent registers derived from the 26/27 MHz crystal. The calculators here do those conversions for you.

outputs.description: Carson's rule (R + 2·f_dev) plus 2× the worst-case TX+RX crystal offset. This rule of thumb is not from the datasheet (see TI DN005).

outputs.expr: band == 315 ? tindex("pa_ml", "dbm", tx_dbm, "pa_315") : band == 433 ? tindex("pa_ml", "dbm", tx_dbm, "pa_433") : band == 868 ? tindex("pa_ml", "dbm", tx_dbm, "pa_868") : tindex("pa_ml", "dbm", tx_dbm, "pa_915")

outputs.label: TX current
outputs.expr: band == 315 ? tindex("pa_ml", "dbm", tx_dbm, "i_315") : band == 433 ? tindex("pa_ml", "dbm", tx_dbm, "i_433") : band == 868 ? tindex("pa_ml", "dbm", tx_dbm, "i_868") : tindex("pa_ml", "dbm", tx_dbm, "i_915")

outputs.label: RX current (at sensitivity)
outputs.expr: band == 315 ? tlookup("rx_current", "drate", clamp(drate_actual, 1.2, 250), "i_315") : band == 433 ? tlookup("rx_current", "drate", clamp(drate_actual, 1.2, 250), "i_433") : tlookup("rx_current", "drate", clamp(drate_actual, 1.2, 250), "i_868")

checks.when: not (between(f_target, spec.band_lo.min, spec.band_lo.max) or between(f_target, spec.band_mid.min, spec.band_mid.max) or between(f_target, spec.band_hi.min, spec.band_hi.max))
checks.message: Target frequency is outside the CC1101 bands (300–348, 387–464, 779–928 MHz).
With a 27 MHz crystal the mid band starts at 392 MHz.
The 'band' selection used for the PA/current tables doesn't match your target frequency.
Supply exceeds the absolute maximum rating (−0.3 to 3.9 V).

checks.when: (vdd < spec.vdd_op.min or vdd > spec.vdd_op.max) and vdd <= spec.vdd_abs.max
checks.message: Supply outside the 1.8–3.6 V operating range.
Temperature outside the −40 to 85 °C operating range.
Above 250 kBaud only 2-FSK and MSK are supported (GFSK/OOK/ASK max 250 kBaud, 4-FSK max 300 kBaud).
Channel filter is narrower than the recommended bandwidth: expect sensitivity loss or no reception. See the channel-filter table.
Requested channel spacing exceeds the maximum (≈405 kHz @ 26 MHz). Use every n-th channel instead.
Deviation can't be hit within 5 % (out of the register's range).
Modulation index < 0.5: consider MSK or a larger deviation for 2-FSK.
Below 1.2 kBaud the sensitivity curve is extrapolated from the 1.2 kBaud value.

notes: Register formulas are from the datasheet. Always cross-check final settings with SmartRF Studio.
The sensitivity curve is built from the tabulated 868 MHz values. Other bands are within about 1–2 dB.
The battery estimate covers radio current only: no MCU, regulator quiescent current, or battery self-discharge.
For EN 300 220 compliance in 863–870 MHz, use a 26 MHz crystal below 869 MHz and a 27 MHz crystal above it.
